title: Announcing Resend Forge
summary: We've built our own MTA (Mail Transfer Agent) from scratch. It's reliable, fast, and provides best-in-class deliverability.
body_markdown:
Resend started at the surface.


[React Email](https://react.email/) lets you **build templates** the same way you build the rest of your app, in components, with code you'd actually want to maintain. We obsessed over the parts you touch every day.


Next, we focused on **sending and receiving** , with special attention to how email creation *felt* to a developer: a modern API, a beautiful dashboard that didn't fight you, a brand that showed deep care and attention to detail.


**It was the right place to start.** The developer experience around email had been neglected for a decade, and fixing it is most of why people came to Resend in the first place.


Today, we're moving down the stack to **the foundational layer** : the infrastructure. Announcing **Resend Forge** , our own email infrastructure (i.e., Mail Transfer Agent). It's reliable, fast, and provides best-in-class deliverability.


## Innovating on the infrastructure layer


The surface can only be as good as what's underneath it.


Email runs on infrastructure most developers never see and never should have to think about. To this point in our history, we ran that infrastructure on a rented foundation.


Today, that changes.


Resend Forge sends from IP blocks we own and operate. **We control the whole path** , from the API you call down to the addresses your email leaves from.


Forge is invisible to you, but provides immediate impacts. Behind all of it is a network of postmasters at the major providers so we can debug directly if something goes wrong.


Here's how Sam Lambert, PlanetScale's CEO, described the improvement:


> "Faster time-to-inbox, fewer retries, and better observability. That's the kind of infrastructure we want underneath us."
>
>
> Sam Lambert
>
>
> CEO of PlanetScale


## The numbers so far


In the last few months, hundreds of customers have sent more than **10 million emails** through Resend Forge. Moving to Forge **requires no code changes** for customers, with immediate improvements of speed and reliability.


[View the interactive version on resend.com](https://resend.com/blog/announcing-resend-forge)


Resend Forge is also leading the way on deliverability for modern email infrastructure.


Hundreds of companies now trust Forge, including Profound, Firecrawl, Clay, and OTown.


## How to activate


Forge is available today to any Resend customer.


Enable it by navigating[to any domain](https://resend.com/domains) in your Resend account and clicking` Activate Resend Forge` . Add a single CNAME record to your DNS, and we'll handle the rest.


Nothing changes in your code and we'll onboard eligible domains silently after DNS verification and sender-reputation checks.


> "Activating Resend Forge was a no-brainer. No code changes. Immediate speed and deliverability improvements. Easy as it gets!"
>
>
> Dylan Babbs
>
>
> Co-Founder and CTO of Profound


Over time, you should see:


- **Faster time-to-inbox** : we control connection pooling directly.
- **More reliable delivery** : we tune retries, backoff, and queue durability.
- **Better visibility** : we have more real-time visibility into your emails.


## A foundation for the future


We spent our first years obsessing over the surface of email. Now we're doing the same to the layer underneath. The best infrastructure is the kind you never have to think about.


[Learn more](https://resend.com/features/forge) or[Activate Forge](https://resend.com/domains) today.
